page.layout: One page of running text, one column, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Margin marks are stray and not notes.

main_text.p: ejusdem fidei colligatas fideliter servatæ sunt, vel pervicacem suadere possit, doctrinam horum librorum alium Authorem quam Deum non agnoscere, qui tam mirabiliter contra Sathanæ ejusq; satellitum furores, qui sacros hosce Codices non tantum adulterare, sed prorsus extirpare omnibus viribus contenderunt, hactenus eos confervavit.

6. In varietatibus autē ut vera lectio eliciatur, quodnam melius vel excogitari poterit medium, quàm optimorum exemplarium & vetustissimarum Versionum collatio, eamq; lectionem quæ cum pluribus, vetustioribus, & melioris notæ libris locisque circumstantiis melius congruit, retinere? Hanc viam iniérunt Hieronymus, Cyrillus, Eusebius, Augustinus reliquique Ecclesiæ antiquæ proceres; eandem Masorethæ Tiberienses in recensendo textu Hebræo, Mercerus, Buxtorfius, &c. in emendandis Targumim; Erasmus, Stephanus, Beza & alii in N.Test. Editionibus Græcis; eandem deniq; inierunt Sixtus 5. & Clem.8. in Græca 70. Vulgataque Latina Editionibus, ut ex Nobilio, Morino, Luca Brugensi aliisque patet.

7. Nec tantum ad lectionem veram, sed & ad genuinum sensum indagandum confert versionum antiquarum collatio; quomodo enim ipsa priscæ Ecclesiæ Lumina Scripturā intellexerint, quemque sensum receperint, hoc modo nobis indicant. Cumq; hodie inter tot schismata, quæ Ecclesiam præcipuè Occidentalem miserè dilacerant, omnes Scripturam pro se allegent, deque Scripturæ vero & genuino sensu lis tota fit & controversia; per versiones ubique receptas totius fere Ecclesiæ, ta locorum quam temporis ratione Catholicæ judicium

page.notes: Stray marks in the margins (a dot left of "Cyrillus", a dot right of "Hieronymus,", a small dash left of "6.", a bullet after "indicant") are not text and are not transcribed. "Sixtus 5." is copied as printed; the numeral may be a Roman V. Some words in the last line are the printer's own forms and were kept as printed. The catchword "um" is printed at the lower right.
